import hashlib,json,shlex,subprocess; from pathlib import Path
report_path="docs/agent/implementation-runs/managed-20261023-fix-manual-history-01.json"; r=json.loads(Path(report_path).read_text()); pending=report_path[:-5]+"/handoff.json"
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(["git",*args])
actual=set(git("diff","--name-only",r["startCommit"]).decode().splitlines())|set(git("ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard").decode().splitlines())|{pending}
assert actual==set(r["changedPaths"]) and len(r["changedPaths"])==len(actual), (actual^set(r["changedPaths"]))
assert not any(k in r for k in ["proposal","workerProposal","implementationUnits","ancestorClosures"])
assert r["reviewedUnitIds"]==[] and r["disposition"]=="fixed-awaiting-independent-check"
for check in r["checks"]:
 if check["evidence"]==pending: continue
 d=json.loads(Path(check["evidence"]).read_text()); assert d["exitCode"]==check["exitCode"]
 if "outputSha256" in d: assert hashlib.sha256(d["output"].encode()).hexdigest()==d["outputSha256"]
 if "command" in check: assert shlex.split(check["command"])==d["command"]
identities=json.loads(json.loads(Path(report_path[:-5]+"/source-identity.json").read_text())["output"])
for p,digest in identities.items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,p
state="docs/agent/implementation-state.json"; assert Path(state).read_bytes()==git("show",r["startCommit"]+":"+state)
paths=[p for p in r["changedPaths"] if Path(p).is_file()]
subprocess.run(["git","--literal-pathspecs","add","--all","--",*paths],check=True)
staged=set(git("diff","--cached","--name-only").decode().splitlines()); assert staged<=set(r["changedPaths"])
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--cached","--check"],check=True); subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check",r["startCommit"]],check=True)
print(json.dumps({"changedPathCount":len(actual),"inspectedStagedPaths":sorted(staged),"sourceIdentityCount":len(identities),"state":"unchanged","checks":"hash/argv/exit match; diagnostic failures retained","disposition":r["disposition"]},indent=2))
